title: PMP® Exam Prep
blurb: Instructor-led PMP preparation covering the full ECO — people, process, business environment — with practice exams and a pass-or-retrain-free guarantee. Taught by a PMP-certified practitioner.

modules.d: The exam, the ECO, and your personalized plan.
modules.body:
Getting started

Exam structure, eligibility, application walkthrough, and your diagnostic assessment → personalized study plan. Learn to use AI as a study partner: adaptive quiz master, scenario simulator, and flash-card generator.

PMI’s own research now treats AI fluency as a core project skill — the profession’s future is human judgment directing machine throughput. You will pass the exam with that combination and lead with it afterward.

modules.d: Team leadership, conflict, and stakeholder engagement.
modules.body:
Coverage

Full People domain with scenario drills — the exam's judgment-heavy heart. Servant-leadership grounding gives Team21 candidates a real edge here.

🧪 Interactive Lab — try it now

You are a PMP exam simulator. Generate 5 situational questions on [ECO domain/topic] at real exam difficulty, one at a time. After each answer, explain why every option is right or wrong, tag the mindset principle involved, and track my score with a readiness verdict at the end.

Coverage

Full Process domain: planning, execution, monitoring across delivery approaches. Practice sets after every unit.

modules.d: Compliance, value delivery, and two timed mock exams.
modules.body:
Coverage

Business Environment domain plus two full timed mock exams with itemized review and a readiness verdict.
